# OMIX Journal

> The OMIX Journal is a technical publication by OMIX Digital Solutions. It publishes practical explanations of software engineering, architecture, AI infrastructure, payments, integrations and business technology. Company ownership and product relationships are disclosed.

## Publication information
- [About the OMIX Journal](https://blog.omixsystems.store/about)
- [Editorial Policy](https://blog.omixsystems.store/editorial-policy)
- [Privacy Policy](https://blog.omixsystems.store/privacy)
- [Terms of Use](https://blog.omixsystems.store/terms)
- [Knowledge Base](https://blog.omixsystems.store/wiki)
- [RSS Feed](https://blog.omixsystems.store/feed.xml)
- [Sitemap](https://blog.omixsystems.store/sitemap.xml)

## Published technical guides
- [Designing Modular Software Systems](https://blog.omixsystems.store/wiki/modular-software-systems): module boundaries, public contracts, data ownership, failure handling and contract tests.
- [AI Model Routing](https://blog.omixsystems.store/wiki/introducing-bifrost): provider adapters, routing policies, timeouts, fallback behavior, security and observability.
- [Reliable Webhook Consumers](https://blog.omixsystems.store/wiki/reliable-webhook-consumers): signature verification, idempotency, durable processing, retries, event ordering and reconciliation.
- [M-PESA STK Push Payment Lifecycle](https://blog.omixsystems.store/wiki/mpesa-stk-push-payment-lifecycle): asynchronous payment states, callback handling, ledger posting and reconciliation for Kenyan payment workflows.
- [Offline-First Business Software](https://blog.omixsystems.store/wiki/offline-first-business-software): local persistence, outbox synchronization, conflict resolution and device security.
- [SMS Commerce Architecture Proposal](https://blog.omixsystems.store/wiki/sms-commerce-feature-phone-architecture): feature-phone shopping sessions, command routing, order/payment states, opt-out and delivery updates.
